414:t_100:1.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't want to kill the Lieutenant Colonel!」

414:t_100:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I warn you: the enemy's maneuverability exceeds mine.」

414:t_100:3.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「The strong and the weak support each other through reason. That is what makes us human. Isn't that right, $$レド$$?」

414:t_100:4.en:
$$レド$$
「It doesn't matter if we're strong or weak...! We're all alive... We're all human!!」

414:t_101:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I'm $$ラケージ$$, the notorious pirate... If you think I'll stay quiet forever, you'll suffer worse than a burn.」

414:t_101:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Savor the power of this $$波乗りロブスター$$! I upgraded it with supplies I got from them!」

414:t_102:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Your resistance is meaningless.」

414:t_102:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Even so, I have a reason I can't back down!」

414:t_102:2.en:
$$レド$$
「If I let you through, $$ガルガンティア$$... $$エイミー$$ and $$ベベル$$ will be in danger! I'll stop that, no matter what!!」

414:t_103:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, I judge you unfit to be a soldier. Therefore, I will eliminate you.」

414:t_103:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Your very existence embodies everything twisted about the $$人類銀河同盟$$!」

414:t_103:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Whatever you say, I'll live! I'll live and fight of my own free will!」

414:t_103:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「My mission is to support Ensign $$レド$$ in battle.」

414:t_103:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's do this, $$チェインバー#pilot$$! There's nothing left to bind us!!」

414:t_104:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ブレラ$$...! This time, I'll stop you!」

414:t_104:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「You can't. I am a perfected soldier. Your combat skills won't work on me.」

414:t_104:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't decide that for me! My wings will tear through the mist over this sea!」

414:t_104:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「For $$ランカ$$, who believes in me and believes you'll come back!!」

414:t_105:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Neither machines nor humans can become something greater than human!」

414:t_105:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll prove it! I'll defeat you, even though I'm just a human!」

414:t_106:0.en:
$n
「Sure, it's easier to give up your own judgment and live by following someone else...」

414:t_106:1.en:
$n
「But can you call that living!? No matter how much I suffer, I'll decide for myself how to live!」

414:t_107:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(I'm sorry, $$ランカ$$... I meant to protect you, but I've made you worry about me again...)

414:t_107:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(But I swear... I'll never make you shed tears of sorrow again...!)

kept_omissions: 414:t_104:3: This row supplies the purpose of Alto's preceding declaration about cutting through the mist.
